related.title: MLPerf 式尾延遲：百分位與負載條件
related.titleEn: MLPerf-style tail latency: percentiles and load
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：邊界一致且穩態成立，取消可回收，平均在系統數未被誤稱最大批次。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Boundaries/steady state hold, cancellations reclaim, and average occupancy is not maximum batch.
related.difference: 明定百分位算法及樣本邊界，避免用平均值宣稱所有請求達標。
related.differenceEn: Declare percentile method/sample boundary and avoid using means to claim universal compliance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 穩定系統Little定律L=λW；W須包含邊界內等待與處理，不能混用只計算時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學λ12請求/s、平均W2.5 s，無長期積壓增長；請求長度分布固定。 平均在系統L=12×2.5=30請求，不等於硬體每一時刻的batch大小。
最近秩法p95取排序後ceil(0.95N)個值；不同插值法可能產生不同結果。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 N100：90筆40 ms、5筆80 ms、5筆200 ms，無丟棄失敗或冷啟動樣本。 第95筆為80 ms，因此p95=80 ms；平均(90×40+5×80+5×200)/100=50 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a stable system, L=λW; W includes waiting and service within the chosen boundary. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teachingλ12 requests/s, W2.5 s, no growing backlog and fixed length distribution. AverageL30 requests, not instantaneous hardware batch size.

related.differenceEn: Draw the main and identity paths meeting at addition; require identical output shapes.; Finite differences agree within teaching tolerance1e−6, with linear assumptions and projection exceptions stated.
